paragraphs.en: Open source repository of plugins primarily intended for knowledge workers to use in Claude Cowork
paragraphs.zh: 主要面向知识工作者在 Claude Cowork 中使用的开源插件仓库

paragraphs.en: Plugins that turn Claude into a specialist for your role, team, and company. Built for Claude Cowork , also compatible with Claude Code .
paragraphs.zh: 将 Claude 变成你的角色、团队和公司的专家的插件。 为 Claude Cowork 打造，同时兼容 Claude Code。

sents.en: Plugins that turn Claude into a specialist for your role, team, and company.
sents.zh: 将 Claude 变成你的角色、团队和公司的专家的插件。

sents.en: Built for Claude Cowork , also compatible with Claude Code .
sents.zh: 为 Claude Cowork 打造，同时兼容 Claude Code。

paragraphs.en: Cowork lets you set the goal and Claude delivers finished, professional work. Plugins let you go further: tell Claude how you like work done, which tools and data to pull from, how to handle critical workflows, and what slash commands to expose — so your team gets better and more consistent outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: Cowork 让你设定目标，由 Claude 交付完成度高的专业成果。 插件让你能更进一步：告诉 Claude 你偏好的工作方式、要调用哪些工具和数据、如何处理关键工作流，以及要开放哪些斜杠命令——从而让你的团队获得更好、更一致的成果。

paragraphs.en: Each plugin bundles the skills, connectors, slash commands, and sub-agents for a specific job function. Out of the box, they give Claude a strong starting point for helping anyone in that role. The real power comes when you customize them for your company — your tools, your terminology, your processes — so Claude works like it was built for your team.
paragraphs.zh: 每个插件都为特定岗位职能打包了技能、连接器、斜杠命令和子智能体。 开箱即用时，它们为 Claude 提供了一个坚实的起点，帮助担任该角色的任何人。 真正的威力在于你为公司对它们进行定制之后——你的工具、你的术语、你的流程——让 Claude 用起来就像专为你的团队打造的一样。

paragraphs.en: We're open-sourcing 11 plugins built and inspired by our own work:
paragraphs.zh: 我们正在开源 11 个由我们自己工作构建并受其启发的插件：

paragraphs.en: Install these directly from Cowork, browse the full collection here on GitHub, or build your own.
paragraphs.zh: 你可以直接在 Cowork 中安装这些智能体，在 GitHub 上浏览完整合集，或者构建你自己的智能体。

paragraphs.en: # Add the marketplace first claude plugin marketplace add anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins # Then install a specific plugin claude plugin install sales@knowledge-work-plugins Once installed, plugins activate automatically. Skills fire when relevant, and slash commands are available in your session (e.g., /sales:call-prep , /data:write-query ).
paragraphs.zh: # 先添加插件市场 claude plugin marketplace add anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins # 然后安装特定插件 claude plugin install sales@knowledge-work-plugins 安装完成后，插件会自动激活。 技能会在相关时自动触发，斜杠命令则可在你的会话中使用（例如 /sales:call-prep、/data:write-query）。

paragraphs.en: Every plugin follows the same structure:
paragraphs.zh: 每个插件都遵循相同的结构：

paragraphs.en: plugin-name/ ├── .claude-plugin/plugin.json # Manifest ├── .mcp.json # Tool connections ├── commands/ # Slash commands you invoke explicitly └── skills/ # Domain knowledge Claude draws on automatically Skills encode the domain expertise, best practices, and step-by-step workflows Claude needs to give you useful help. Claude draws on them automatically when relevant. Commands are explicit actions you trigger (e.g., /finance:reconciliation , /product-management:write-spec ). Connectors wire Claude to the external tools your role depends on — CRMs, project trackers, data warehouses, design tools, and more — via MCP servers . Every component is file-based — markdown and JSON, no code, no infrastructure, no build steps.
paragraphs.zh: plugin-name/ ├── .claude-plugin/plugin.json # 清单文件 ├── .mcp.json # 工具连接 ├── commands/ # 你显式调用的斜杠命令 └── skills/ # Claude 自动运用的领域知识 技能（Skills）将 Claude 为你提供有效帮助所需的领域专长、最佳实践和分步骤工作流进行编码。 当相关时，Claude 会自动运用它们。 命令是你触发的显式操作（例如 /finance:reconciliation、/product-management:write-spec）。 连接器（Connectors）通过 MCP 服务器将 Claude 接入你的角色所依赖的外部工具——CRM、项目跟踪器、数据仓库、设计工具等等。 每个组件都基于文件——只有 markdown 和 JSON，无需代码，无需基础设施，无需构建步骤。

paragraphs.en: As your team builds and shares plugins, Claude becomes a cross-functional expert. The context you define gets baked into every relevant interaction, so leaders and admins can spend less time enforcing processes and more time improving them.
paragraphs.zh: 随着你的团队构建并分享插件，Claude 成为一名跨职能专家。 你定义的上下文会被固化到每一次相关交互中，因此领导和管理员可以少花时间执行流程，多花时间改进流程。
